Vendored snapshot of "limina" (https://github.com/KadenMc/limina), v0.1.0,
forked into agentic-experiments on 2026-04-20. One-time fork; not resynced.

The H->E->F artifact model, the kb/ layout, the templates/, and the
methodology skills under this directory originate from that project and
have since been adapted as agentic-experiments' own research scaffold.

Adaptations applied during vendoring:
- The 4 shell hooks were replaced with cross-platform Python ports; they
  now live in the aexp package (aexp.hooks.*) and are wired up by
  `aexp install`.
- The upstream .claude/settings.json was folded into the settings merge
  that `aexp install` performs.
- The upstream setup.sh and requirements.txt were dropped: project setup
  is `aexp install`, and dependencies live in agentic-experiments'
  pyproject.toml.
